title: ethulia vernonioides
intro: Ethulia vernonioides, commonly known as the golden daisy or bush marigold, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, acting as an antimicrobial agent, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ethulia vernonioides include flavonoids, saponins, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as pain relief and wound healing. The plant's leaves and flowers have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions.
